title: First bacteriophage genomes designed by a genome language model
summary: The Arc Institute group used Evo to design genomes resembling that of phage ΦX174: of 285 designs, 16 yielded functional phages (67–392 mutations from the closest natural one; 13 had never-seen mutations). They infect only two E. coli strains; a cocktail overcame resistance in three evolved strains. bioRxiv preprint; peer review is unconfirmed.
